description: Starts a campaign as a draft, with a name and the WhatsApp number it goes out on, whether it retries failed sends by itself (auto_retry) and the most messages it sends an hour (max_per_hour), and returns it with its id. It sends nothing and messages nobody: a draft waits until a person approves it. The draft is on the Campaigns page of the Cosend dashboard too. Campaigns are on the Starter plan and above, and for owners and admins.

auto_retry.description: Retries failed sends by itself: a person not on WhatsApp is not retried, a message WhatsApp held back is retried once, 24 hours later, and any other failure up to 3 more times, 30 minutes, 2 hours and 6 hours after it. Switched off, retries not yet sent stop.

max_per_hour.description: The most messages it sends an hour, from 60 to 100000; null sends as fast as the number allows.

name: create_campaign
title: Start a campaign draft
